mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 1.5% in a single month, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5% in a month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in private sector employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) above 1100 thousand units signals robust housing demand that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST exceeds 1100 thousand units, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 104.0 in a monthly reading, it signals a manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 104.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the core consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 240.0 in a monthly reading indicates persistent inflation that erodes real corporate profits and increases the risk of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 240.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction permits (HOUST) exceed 1150 thousand units in a monthly reading, it signals robust housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1150.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime, a simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% and decline in private sector employment (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during recessionary regimes when UNRATE rises above 4.5% and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.
